roadmap: 21 sub-item: the History bar vanished while a command ran or a sketch was open
tier: feature (behaviour change: one independent audit + one actual run)
before: run01: .history absent from the page during a palette command (Box) and an open sketch; back when idle
change: App: historyShown = !rendering; busy = sketch || command. FeatureHistoryBar: busy -> class busy (opacity 0.45), aria-disabled, a title, and click/double-click/context-menu stopped at the bar (it stays hit-testable, so nothing reaches its steps or the viewport under it)

findings.F1 medium: the first version used inert, which browsers treat as pointer-events none: clicks on the dimmed bar fell through to the viewport (placing a box, adding a sketch point, picking an edge under it) -> fixed: no inert, events swallowed at the bar
findings.F2 medium: the driver clicked with force and compared too little state -> fixed: elementFromPoint at a step must be the bar; a real click and double-click must leave document, HUD, sketch panel and picks unchanged
findings.F3 low: in narrow windows a floating HUD now overlaps the bottom view bar by about 8 px during a command (recorded as a limit)

actualRun.run02: inert version: PASS on the weak driver (kept as evidence of what the audit found)
actualRun.run03: final source: PASS; during the command and the sketch the bar stays at the same box (44,960,1096x40), dimmed (0.45), busy; the element at a step's centre is the bar; a real click and double-click change nothing; idle again it takes clicks and a step opens its feature editor; no page or console errors; root reviewed the sketch screenshot

limits: Step names still off by default (the existing toggle stays)
Floating HUD may overlap the bottom view bar by ~8 px in narrow windows during a command (F3)
No History timeline redesign (first/prev/next/last buttons of the reference CAD)
